decisions.reason: Transactional email is the firm's flagship and matches its strategic direction, so even with no website evidence for 2020 to 2021 the option's likely value justifies keeping and investing further.

Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflow strategy and runs on its existing infrastructure, so holding it costs little, though its missing visibility in 2020 to 2021 raises some doubt.
Email and fax conversion is cheap to run on the established fax platform and still serves regulated customers, though declining fax use limits its upside.

Multi-engine scanning remains a low-cost part of the email security offering, but its lack of separate visibility suggests it may soon be folded into a bundle, much as the sandbox product was withdrawn.
